test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A boatman rows 15 km in 15 minutes, along the stream and 10 km in 1 hour against the stream. Find the speed of the boat in still water.
solution:
**Given:**

A boatman rows 15 km in 15 minutes, along the stream

10 km in 1 hour against the stream.

**Concept used:**

Speed of the boat = (Downstream speed + Upstream speed) / 2

**Calcuation:**

The boat goes 15 km in 15 minute

So, Speed will be 15 × 4 = 60 km/h

Again,

The boat goes 10 km in 1 hour against the stream.

Speed of the boat will be,

⇒ (60 + 10) / 2 

⇒ 35 km/h

**∴ The speed of the boat in still water is 35 km/h.**
